project_type: C11 web framework with CLI and static library (libkern). kernd is a new binary target - a VPS dashboard daemon.
build_system: CMake 3.16+. Compiler flags: -std=c11 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra. _GNU_SOURCE defined for libuv. kernd is a separate binary target in CMakeLists.txt linking against libkern.
test_framework: Custom test framework (kern_test.h). Tests use macros: TEST(name), RUN_TEST(name), ASSERT, ASSERT_EQ_INT, ASSERT_EQ_STR, ASSERT_NULL, ASSERT_NOT_NULL. Each test file has its own main(). Files: tests/test_<module>.c
verification_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/kern/build && cmake .. && make -j$(nproc) (zero warnings). 2. ctest --output-on-failure (all tests pass). 3. ./kernd --version prints version.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed (libuv-devel, sqlite-devel). Build: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. && make -j$(nproc)
environment_constraints: Amazon Linux 2023, gcc, cmake, libuv 1.51.0, sqlite 3.40.0. Full internet. No Docker needed. cgroups v2 available (but tests should gracefully handle missing cgroup fs).
contribution_requirements: C11 strict, no GNU extensions beyond _GNU_SOURCE for libuv. Naming: kern_module_action() or kernd_module_action() for public. Types: snake_case_t. Constants: KERN_UPPER_SNAKE or KERND_UPPER_SNAKE. 4-space indent, same-line braces. Every malloc has corresponding free. Return int 0=success/-1=failure.
key_patterns: HTTP server uses libuv event loop (kern_http_server.c). Router is a radix tree (kern_router.c). Config uses TOML parser with dotted keys (kern_config.c). Sessions are in-memory with cookie-based IDs (kern_session.c). Queue uses pthreads with mutex/condvar (kern_queue.c). App bootstrap in kern_app.c creates loop, server, router, db. Response serialization via kern_response_serialize(). kern_dict_t for hash maps, kern_buf_t for string building. Password hashing via kern_password_hash()/kern_password_verify() using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.
directory_structure: include/ (kern.h, kern_test.h), src/ (32 .c files for libkern), cli/ (main.c + cmd_*.c), tests/ (30 test files + fixtures/), static/ (kern-shards.js), docs/. NEW: kernd/ directory parallel to cli/ for the daemon binary.
